subject: potassium
correct: JBDS-IP DKA guideline: K+ >5.5 no KCl; 3.5–5.5 add 40 mmol/L; <3.5 senior/critical-care review — additional potassium required. JBDS does not clearly instruct GPs/teams to 'hold the insulin' (the ADA uses <3.3 mmol/L as an insulin-hold threshold).
source: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC5871863/ (tabulates JBDS bands); JBDS-IP DKA guideline 2023 (abcd.care) — primary text not retrievable this pass
note: tools/management/dka.html and dka-print.html say 'if K⁺ is <3.5, hold the insulin, give IV KCl and recheck before restarting'. This is the ADA approach (threshold 3.3), not clearly the JBDS one (senior review + more potassium; FRIII continues). Hospital-phase detail, low primary-care impact. Owner: keep, or replace with 'if K⁺ is <3.5, seek senior/critical-care review — additional potassium is needed (JBDS)'? Also note the raw '<3.5' sits inside a JS html string — check it renders (should be <).
